title: ADR-012: ClickHouse as the dashboard query engine
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-03-04 · Owners: Query Platform

Context

Dashboard tiles issue thousands of small aggregate queries per minute over tenant event tables. Postgres read replicas hit their limit at ~200M rows per tenant.

Decision

Interactive dashboard queries are served by our self-managed ClickHouse clusters. We will not run dashboard tiles on Apache Druid or on a Snowflake account we operate.

Alternatives considered

  • Apache Druid: rejected; ingestion-time rollups make schema changes painful and the ops footprint (ZooKeeper, historicals, brokers) is too big for our team.
  • Snowflake (hosted by us): rejected; per-query credit cost at our tile volume is roughly 6x ClickHouse and cold-start latency breaks the 1s tile budget.

Consequences

Customers can still connect their own Snowflake or Druid as a source through connectors; this ADR is about where our dashboards execute.

title: ADR-015: Stripe Billing for subscriptions and invoicing
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-01-20 · Owners: Billing team

Context

We sell seat-based and usage-based plans, monthly and annual, with enterprise POs.

Decision

All subscriptions, usage metering and invoices are handled by Stripe Billing. We do not build an in-house invoicing or metering system.

Alternatives considered

  • Chargebee: rejected; duplicate customer records with Stripe payments and extra sync jobs.
  • Recurly: rejected; weak usage-based pricing support.
  • In-house invoicing: rejected; tax, dunning and credit notes are a full team's worth of work.

title: ADR-018: Temporal for connector sync orchestration
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-04-11 · Owners: Connectors team

Context

Connector syncs are long-running, need retries with backoff, resumable backfills and per-tenant concurrency limits.

Decision

Every connector sync and backfill is orchestrated as a Temporal workflow. No new schedulers for connector syncs.

Alternatives considered

  • Apache Airflow: rejected; DAG-per-connector-instance does not scale to 40k instances and the scheduler is a single bottleneck.
  • AWS Step Functions: rejected; 25k event history limit breaks large backfills and it locks orchestration to one cloud.
  • Kubernetes CronJobs: rejected; no retries/resume semantics.

title: ADR-021: WorkOS for enterprise SSO and SCIM
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-05-02 · Owners: Identity team

Decision

Enterprise SSO (SAML, OIDC) and SCIM directory sync are integrated through WorkOS. We do not implement SAML or SCIM protocol handling ourselves.

Alternatives considered

  • Auth0: rejected; enterprise connection pricing per IdP is prohibitive.
  • Okta Customer Identity: rejected; would force a migration of our existing password login.
  • Hand-rolled SAML (python3-saml): rejected; XML signature wrapping bugs are a recurring CVE class.

title: ADR-007: Metabase embedding for customer-facing reports
storage:
Status: Superseded by ADR-027 (in-house report renderer) · Date: 2025-06-18 · Owners: Reports team

Decision

Customer-facing scheduled reports are rendered by embedding Metabase via signed embed URLs.

Alternatives considered

  • Looker embedded: rejected on cost.

Note 2026-02: superseded; reports now use the in-house renderer. Do not build on this.

title: ADR-024: Move event ingestion from Kinesis to Kafka (MSK)
storage:
Status: Proposed · Date: 2026-10-14 · Owners: Ingestion team

Context

Kinesis shard limits and 7-day retention make replays awkward.

Decision (proposed)

Replace Kinesis with Amazon MSK for all ingestion streams. Under review; not yet accepted. Until accepted, Kinesis remains the standard.

Alternatives

  • Redpanda Cloud: still being evaluated.

title: Engineering Handbook: Tenant Isolation Standard
storage:
Tenant Isolation Standard

Applies to all services that read customer data in the shared ClickHouse and Postgres clusters.

Standard

Every query against tenant data needs a tenant_id predicate and must go through TenantScopedClient. Raw driver connections (clickhouse_connect, psycopg, JDBC) to shared production clusters are not allowed in application or job code.

Exception

The Internal Analytics team may run read-only, cross-tenant aggregate jobs against the anonymized replica (ch-anon) only. This exception does not cover the production shared clusters.

title: Policy: Customer Data Retention After Termination
storage:
Customer Data Retention After Termination

Policy

No customer data may be kept longer than 30 days after contract termination or account cancellation. This includes warehouse tables, dashboards, exports, snapshots and backups.

Scoped exception

Invoices and billing records are retained for 7 years for tax purposes (Finance). This exception covers billing records only, not customer datasets.

Owner: Legal & Security.

title: 2026-08-26 Connectors guild meeting notes
storage:
Attendees: Connectors, AppSec, SRE

Discussion

  • NetSuite beta incident: one 40GB tenant saturated the sync workers for 6 hours.
  • AppSec found an SSRF in a beta connector's custom-endpoint field.

Outcomes

  • Decision: Before any connector goes GA (general availability, beta label removed), it must pass a load test against the 10x tenant fixture and an AppSec security review.

Action items

  • SRE: publish 10x fixture.
  • AppSec: review template.

title: Secrets Handling Rules / 시크릿 관리 규칙
storage:
Secrets Handling

규칙

Customer credentials (warehouse passwords, service account keys, OAuth access and refresh tokens) are never stored anywhere other than Vault: not in Postgres, Redis, logs, error tables or files. Services fetch them at use time via the Vault agent.

Notes

Masked values (e.g. last 4 chars) are not secrets and may be shown in UI.

title: Data Residency Standard (EU tenants)
storage:
Data Residency

Rule

Data belonging to EU-region tenants is stored and processed only in eu-west-1. No replication, log shipping, rendering or processing of EU tenant data in other regions.

Exception

Aggregated, non-identifying usage counters (rows ingested, seat counts) per EU tenant may be sent to the billing service in us-east-1 for invoicing. Nothing else.

title: 2026-07-08 가격정책 회의록
storage:
참석: 재무, 프라이싱 PM, 빌링팀

논의

  • 지난 분기 사전 고지 없이 좌석 단가를 올려 해지 문의가 급증함.

결정 사항

  • 결정: 기존 고객에게 적용되는 가격 인상은 CFO 승인을 받아야 하며, 적용일 최소 60일 전에 고객에게 고지한다. 신규 가입 고객 대상 가격 변경은 해당 없음.

title: 대시보드 쿼리 타임아웃 원칙
storage:
쿼리 타임아웃

원칙

대시보드 인터랙티브 쿼리의 타임아웃은 60초를 초과할 수 없다. 테넌트·플랜과 관계없이 동일하다.

예외

예약 리포트(scheduled export) 배치 작업은 최대 15분까지 허용한다. 이 예외는 사용자가 화면에서 실행하는 쿼리에는 적용되지 않는다.

title: Production Database Access Guideline
storage:
Production Database Access

원칙 (Guideline)

No direct access (psql, DB console, SQL client) to production databases without an open PagerDuty break-glass ticket. No standing access grants, including read-only, for humans.

How

Use admin tooling for routine fixes. For incidents, open a break-glass ticket; access is auto-revoked after 4 hours.
